closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, easy to fit into familiar meals, and easy protein delivery for normal diets, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It's good for practical meals, blood and oxygen support, and bone health because it's easy to build meals around, vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, and calcium can support bones.
